crossRefs.note: He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one…
“Now therefore, if you have dealt truly and righteously, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt…
There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks…
Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.
translations.bsb: They did not show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) for all the good things he had done for Israel.
translations.kjv: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.
translations.asv: neither showed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had showed unto Israel.
